name: CKEditor Heading Size
description: Adds a CKEditor 5 contextual control that applies a size class to a heading, so its appearance can vary without changing its level.
project_description:
This module provides a CKEditor 5 plugin that lets an editor set a font size on a heading tag without changing its level. Clicking a heading in the editor opens a contextual balloon dropdown of configured sizes; the choice is stored as a CSS class (e.g. h2.heading-size-24px) on the heading, not as an inline style or a changed tag, so the document outline stays intact.

Installation: install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. See https://www.drupal.org/node/895232 for further information.

Configuration: configure the font size options at /admin/config/content/ckeditor-heading-size . You can supply either literal size options (which the module turns into generated CSS rules) or key|value pairs mapping a label to a theme-provided class.
